snippet.title: Hexistence Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Hexistence is a Tower Defense Deck Builder based on four universal elements: Matter, Energy, Space & Time. Place powerful towers and play wondrous spells to defend the Hexspire from the waves of Ethereals sent by the Ether...
Dispel the Ether.
Channel the Elements.
Restore Hexistence!

Check out the demo on Steam!
